summary: Pin is on a riverside footpath and lawn; no vehicle way in.
reasons: Pedestrian path and memorial lawn only
No tyre tracks or vehicles seen
Busy Southbank road has no kerb parking

drivers.seclusion: Open riverside park beside the maritime museum and busy Southbank apartments; very public.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed footpath and grass only; no vehicle route reaches the pin. Museum yard looks private.
drivers.traffic: Arterial and cycleway 50 m south; river to the north.
drivers.convention: No campervans or overnight use seen.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m, Brisbane River 127 m away on the mapped line
Noise from arterial road and Southbank
